Preserve this tradeoff instead of narrating uniformly successful finishing.

editorial.title: Control over a sustained sample
editorial.why: Forty IPL pressure matches, adequate 2026 evidence and first place under all outcome mixes support the control case.
editorial.caution: There is no T20I corroboration here; a wicketless segment must be interpreted alongside runs conceded.
editorial.contribution: Middle-over control supported by retained IPL evidence, with wicket-taking examined alongside concessions.
editorial.review: middle-over-heavy IPL-only evidence, forty pressure matches, adequate 2026 evidence and first in every outcome mix. Delhi three conceded in thirteen pressure attempts without a wicket (50372) supports control; Hyderabad fourteen in seven wicketless attempts (20199) is counterevidence. A wicketless segment is not automatically poor bowling. The sizeable peer-relative lead is retained-IPL evidence, not international or future-role proof.
